page.notes: The marginal note on the right reads "Decretum Ducis Albani." (set over two lines, "Decretum" / "Ducis Albani." with the hyphenated "Al-" / "bani."), beside the line "Ejus summa haec". The Greek words "ἐπιχώριον" and "ἐπείσακτον" are uncertain in their final letters; the first is marked [?]. The line ends on the partial word "pet" and continues on the next page, as printed.
